correctness.rationale: The logit update is exact. Eliminating q from (T,Q) produces t-B sigmoid(t)=z with q uniquely recovered. The derivative has zero, one degenerate, or two simple zeros according as B<4, B=4, or B>4; proper limits give exact global real inverse counts. For B>4 a pair of physical admissible inverse branches exists by local continuity near a fold at any interior q. Threshold algebra and the series W(B)=(B-4)^(3/2)/3+O((B-4)^(5/2)) were reconstructed; symbolic Jacobian, cubic Taylor series, and 436 finite inverse/parameter checks reproduced by same-reviewer checks.

value.rationale: For an explicitly analyzed risk-sensitive game map, the sharp physical injectivity boundary, simultaneous global ambient inverse multiplicity and cubic fold-width law supply natural qualitative information absent from equilibrium and bifurcation plots. They show arbitrarily high learning intensity can coexist with global invertibility through sufficiently rapid belief adaptation and identify whether folding, rather than a complex but invertible map, can underlie transient dynamics.
